hints.content:
For the $x$ pattern, we subtract $8$ from each row.

For the $y$ pattern, we add $8$ more to each row.

Pattern $x$: Subtract $\goldE{8}$

$\begin{align}\text{Starting term}&: \blueE{25}\\\\
\text{Term 2}&:\blueE{25} - \goldE{8}=\maroonE{17}\\\\
\text{Term 3}&:\maroonE{17} - \goldE{8}=\purpleD{9}\end{align}$

Pattern $y$: Add $\tealE{8}$

$\begin{align}\text{Starting term}&: \blueE{13}\\\\
\text{Term 2}&:\blueE{13} + \tealE{8}=\maroonE{21}\\\\
\text{Term 3}&:\maroonE{21} + \tealE{8}=\purpleD{29}\end{align}$

Our table of values should look like this:

$x$ | $y$ 
- | - | -
$25$ | $13$ 
$17$ | $21$ 
$9$ | $29$
